key.name: replace-osd
key.summary: Show volume, brightness and other OSD popups in the island instead of the centre of the screen

key.name: notification-peek
key.summary: Briefly show new notifications in the island (GNOME banners still appear)

key.name: workspace-peek
key.summary: Show the workspace indicator in the island on a workspace switch, instead of GNOME's switcher popup

key.name: media-peek
key.summary: Expand the island for a few seconds when a new track starts
